meta.name: Man vs Bee
meta.description:
Bumbling dad Trevor tries to get the best of a cunning bee while house-sitting a posh mansion — but only unleashes more chaos in this comedy series.

Rated TV-PG · Ended · First aired 24 Jun 2022 · United Kingdom · Language: English
Studio: HouseSitter Productions, Redrum Films · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Doting dad Trevor Bingley arrives at a couple's lavish home to house-sit while they're away. A bee follows closely behind — and the battle begins.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Trevor tries to remember the codes to unlock the library and prevent further damage. Later, he must reschedule upcoming plans with his daughter.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: A police officer checks in on things. Cupcake ruins her prescription dog diet with peanut butter. Trevor releases the bee outside — but not for long.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: With Cupcake's help, Trevor finds a messy way back inside and deals major damage with a kitchen hand mixer before the police officer arrives again.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Trevor cleans up with a shower under flashy lights and a groovy soundtrack. Later, the bee leads Trevor to the couple's grand piano.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Trevor tries to repair more damaged art. After chatting with Maddy, Trevor becomes too preoccupied with the bee to notice art burglars have broken in.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: The burglars reveal themselves at an opportune time. Trevor must take Cupcake to the vet after his bee trap doesn't go as planned.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Trevor gets behind the wheel of Christian's expensive car to head to the vet. Later, a desperate Trevor devises a way to get rid of the bee for good.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: With Nina and Christian on their way back home, Trevor goes in pursuit of his unrelenting rival with blazing fury.
